stories.h: November's full moon dazzles skywatchers with a stunning Beaver Moon supermoon (photos)
stories.t: From the skyscrapers of New York to the ancient Parthenon in Athens, the Beaver Moon supermoon put on a spectacular show for skywatchers around the world.

stories.h: A space telescope hunting for dark matter just discovered something unexpected
stories.t: ESA’s Euclid space telescope has discovered its first previously unknown comet, despite being designed to study distant galaxies and the mysteries of the dark Universe. 3 billion kilometers from Earth and follows an unusual orbit that takes thousands of years to complete.

stories.h: Physicists trap antimatter in a breakthrough that could explain why the universe exists
stories.t: Positrons are the antimatter counterpart of an electron. Physicists trapped a positron and cooled it to temperatures near absolute zero. Positron is suspended in a wall-free trap, safely separated from ordinary matter.
